title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Sharp Consultancy is working with a growing business based in Penistone who are looking to appoint an experienced Accounts Assistant to join their finance team.

This is a genuinely varied role that would suit someone who enjoys having responsibility across different areas of finance rather than being restricted to one part of the function.

Working closely with the Group Financial Controller, you'll have involvement across sales ledger, credit control, invoicing, customer accounts, reporting and month-end finance, as well as working closely with customers and internal teams.

What will you be doing?

Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing and allocating daily customer receipts and bank transactions
- Managing customer accounts and carrying out credit control
- Investigating and resolving payment and account queries
- Raising daily customer invoices and credit notes
- Producing commercial and export invoices
- Managing customer queries and supporting order processing
- Carrying out credit checks on new customers
- Working with the Sales Director around credit limits and payment terms
- Producing weekly customer and management reports
- Supporting month-end processes and account reconciliations
- Posting intercompany transactions and assisting with VAT reporting
- Processing customer credit card payments
- Maintaining accurate financial records and supporting documentation

What are we looking for?

You'll ideally have 2 years' experience within a finance or accounts environment, with a good understanding of sales ledger and credit control.

You'll also need:
- Previous experience using Sage accounting software or similar system
- Good Excel and Microsoft Office skills
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy
- Excellent communication and customer service skills
- Good numerical and analytical ability
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
- A proactive, organised and questioning approach

Why consider the role?

This is a great opportunity for an experienced Accounts Assistant who wants a varied finance role with real ownership and responsibility. You'll be working closely with senior members of the finance team while gaining exposure to a broad range of accounting processes.

Sharp Consultancy is a finance and accountancy recruitment specialist assisting accounting and finance divisions of businesses in the Yorkshire and Derbyshire area. With over 30 years' experience we pride ourselves on sourcing excellent finance professionals across all divisions of an accounts function.

Candidates must be eligible to work in the UK full time without restriction. To apply please send your CV to the e-mail address stated, quoting our reference and specifying which website you saw this position advertised on. Due to the high volume of applications, we receive it is not always possible to respond to unsuccessful applicants. Therefore, if we have not responded to your application within seven days, please note that on this occasion your application has not been successful.

title: Assistant Accountant
description:
A modern, cloud focused accountancy practice in Sheffield is looking to appoint an Assistant Accountant to its growing team. The firm has a very flexible approach to how and where people work, with a relaxed but professional culture and a strong focus on using technology to provide an efficient service to clients.

You will join an established accounts team and take responsibility for a varied portfolio, including a significant client operating within the property and construction sector. This role requires someone who is comfortable managing work from start to finish and dealing directly with clients. Previous CIS experience is essential, alongside a good working knowledge of Xero.

Responsibilities
- Manage the day to day accounting requirements for a portfolio of clients
- Take ownership of work from initial records through to completion
- Prepare year end accounts for a range of owner managed businesses
- Prepare and submit VAT returns
- Handle CIS accounting and compliance requirements
- Work extensively with Xero and other cloud accounting systems
- Respond to client queries and maintain regular client contact
- Build a strong working relationship with a key property and construction client
- Assist with client payroll requirements, with training available where required
- Work closely with bookkeeping and accounts colleagues across the wider team

Candidate Profile
- Previous experience within an accountancy practice or a relevant construction or property finance environment
- Practical CIS experience is essential
- Confident user of Xero
- AAT qualified or studying towards completion would be well suited, although experience will also be considered
- Experience preparing VAT returns and year end accounts
- Comfortable dealing directly with clients and handling routine queries independently
- Able to manage workload effectively when working remotely
- Payroll experience would be useful but is not essential as training can be provided

Package and Working Pattern
- £30,000 to £33,000+, dependent on experience
- Profit share bonus scheme with strong historic payouts
- Very flexible hybrid working with the option to divide time between home and the Sheffield office
- No fixed requirement for particular office days, with the team typically meeting in person around two to three days per week
- Flexible working hours to accommodate personal and family commitments
- Standard workplace pension
- City centre office environment with support towards parking costs where applicable
- Relaxed dress code and a modern approach to working practices

IPS Finance has 45 years' experience in the Yorkshire accountancy recruitment market. We have built our business on long term relationships with both individuals and clients in all sectors, bringing real benefits to all concerned. Please visit our website to view the latest accountancy / finance and practice opportunities.

title: Assistant Management Accountant
description:
Assistant Management Accountant
Sheffield, South Yorkshire

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an ambitious finance professional to join a growing business as an Assistant Management Accountant.

The role would suit either a Finance/Accounting graduate looking to start their career in management accounting, or someone with existing finance experience who is looking to take the next step, broaden their exposure and progress their career.

We are open to candidates at different stages of their finance career, including graduates and those already working in finance who are ready to step up and progress.

You are likely to have:
- A relevant degree and/or previous finance experience.
- AAT qualified or studying towards CIMA, ACCA, or equivalent.
- A good understanding of accounting fundamentals.
- Strong Excel skills and confidence working with financial data.
- Excellent attention to detail and organisation.
- Good communication and relationship-building skills.
- A proactive, inquisitive approach and desire to develop.

- Professional study support
- Hybrid working

- Exposure to management accounting, FP&A and commercial finance
- Opportunity to work closely with senior Finance and commercial stakeholders
- Clear scope for career development and increasing responsibility

title: Remote Conveyancing Paralegal
company: LEGAL TALENT PARTNERS LIMITED - Agency - Permanent
description:
Remote Conveyancing Paralegal

£

Quality. Technology. Flexibility. A Better Way to Do Conveyancing.

We're partnering with a fast-growing, forward-thinking residential conveyancing firm that is using technology, smarter processes and a collaborative team structure to change the way property law is delivered.

The firm is built around a simple idea: conveyancing should be simpler, clearer and faster - for clients and the people delivering it.

If you're an experienced conveyancing paralegal looking for greater autonomy, better technology, a sustainable workload and the flexibility of a fully remote role, this could be an excellent next move.

Why This Role Stands Out

This is not a traditional conveyancing environment where paralegals are left to manage overwhelming caseloads with little support.

You'll work within small, collaborative teams, with regular check-ins, structured 1-to-1s, feedback and personalised training.

The firm takes a quality over quantity approach to workload, maintaining sustainable caseloads and giving teams capacity to deal with peaks without compromising client service.

You'll benefit from:
- Sustainable caseloads and a strong focus on work-life balance
- Small, collaborative teams
- Regular support, feedback and development
- Bespoke technology designed around legal teams
- A culture where asking for help is encouraged
- The opportunity to influence how technology and processes develop
- Fully remote working with genuine flexibility

The result? A more manageable workload, better support and the freedom to focus on delivering excellent conveyancing rather than simply processing as many files as possible.

The Role

As a Conveyancing Paralegal, you'll be an integral part of a residential conveyancing team, working alongside lawyers and other paralegals to deliver an excellent client service.

You'll work across freehold and leasehold sales, purchases and remortgages, taking ownership of your matters while working collaboratively with the wider team.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Progressing residential sales, purchases and remortgages
- Handling freehold sales with minimal supervision
- Managing most leasehold sale enquiries with minimal supervision
- Managing most freehold purchase enquiries with minimal supervision
- Liaising with clients, solicitors, estate agents and other third parties
- Proactively identifying issues and keeping transactions moving
- Reviewing and responding to enquiries
- Maintaining clear, jargon-free communication
- Using the firm's technology to manage your caseload efficiently
- Identifying and resolving potential issues before they become blockers
- Providing feedback to improve systems and processes

The firm's technology has been developed specifically around its conveyancing process, and legal professionals are encouraged to provide feedback on the tools they use every day.

About you

You'll ideally have:
- Strong experience in residential conveyancing
- Experience handling freehold sales with limited supervision
- Experience dealing with leasehold sale enquiries
- Experience dealing with freehold purchase enquiries
- Confidence communicating with clients and third parties
- A proactive approach to progressing transactions
- Strong organisation and attention to detail
- Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
- Confidence working independently in a remote environment
- An interest in using technology to improve legal work

You don't need to be qualified. This role is suited to an experienced paralegal with strong technical conveyancing skills who is ready to take greater ownership of their work.

Although fully remote, you won't be left alone with a laptop and a pile of files. Regular team check-ins, 1-to-1s and ongoing feedback are built into the firm's approach.

The Culture:

This is a firm deliberately doing things differently.

Rather than chasing maximum utilisation, it takes a sustainable approach to workload, helping teams maintain consistent service levels while giving people room to deal with the unexpected.

Its technology helps allocate work, streamline processes and keep teams informed, while its remote-working model is built around communication, supervision, feedback and development.

There's also a strong culture of transparency and continuous improvement. People are encouraged to share ideas, challenge processes and help shape the future of the business.

The Package
- £30,000-£40,000 depending on experience
- Fully remote - work from anywhere in the UK
- Flexible working hours
- 25 days' holiday + 3 days at Christmas + Bank Holidays
- Full home-working setup and equipment provided
- Comprehensive private healthcare
- Free access to Spill mental health and wellbeing support
- Company pension scheme
- Enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption leave
- Growth Shares, giving employees an opportunity to share in the long-term success of the business
- Fully paid-for annual company weekend
- Structured development and genuine progression opportunities

The firm's flexible approach is a key part of its culture, with many employees working flexible hours or part-time. The focus is on creating working patterns that work for both the individual and the wider team.

If you're an experienced conveyancing paralegal looking for a genuinely modern, supportive and flexible place to build your career, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: We are looking for a Medical Receptionist to join our busy and evolving team. Job Purpose To provide a high-quality front-line reception service to our patients and colleagues and to ensure the day-to-day activities are performed in a timely and efficient manner. As a receptionist you are the first point of contact for people contacting the surgery and it is vital that you project a positive, friendly and professional image to patients and other visitors. You will be responsible for a wide range of reception duties including care navigation, office administration, call handling and liaising with patients which will enable the practice to deliver a quality service to our patients. The role is varied and requires significant customer service experience as well as excellent communication skills; you should be a motivated, enthusiastic and friendly person with a positive attitude towards working within the NHS and general practice and a willingness to adapt to changing demands within the NHS. Post Hours The successful candidate must be able to work approximately 23-25 hours per week over 5 days and must be flexible to work within our practice core hours of 7.30am - 6.30pm. You will be required to be flexible to cover when needed for holidays, sickness & other absences. Ensure an effective & efficient reception service is provided to patients & other visitors to the practice. Deal with all general enquiries from patients, doctors, staff & other agencies, explaining surgery procedures, making new & follow-up appointments. Care navigate & direct patients to the most appropriate source of help. Action requests for repeat prescriptions & ensure they are processed as per our protocol within 48 hours. Setting out letters, new prescriptions & repeat prescriptions for checking by the doctor before collection by the patient or sending to the pharmacy. Filing & extracting patients records & any documents relating to these be it from paper or electronic records. Entering patient information accurately & in a timely manner onto the patient record or clinical system. Dealing with the incoming post & other forms of communication, scanning & distributing it to the appropriate members of the practice team. Receiving & passing on messages in an accurate & timely manner to clinical & managerial staff as well as passing on all requests for home visits to the appropriate clinician, ensuring careful recording of all relevant details. Updating patient details as requested in an accurate & timely manner. Liaising with other outside agencies including hospitals, ambulance control, out of hours services or other bodies by telephone or email. Medical Receptionist Job Description Post: Medical Receptionist Accountable to: Practice Manager & Assistant Practice Manager Place of work: Norwood Medical Centre Primary Responsibilities Ensure an effective and efficient reception service is provided to patients and other visitors to the practice. Organise and plan room usage on the day. Deal with all general enquiries from patients, doctors, staff and other agencies, explaining surgery procedures, making new and follow-up appointments over the telephone or with direct patient contact. Care navigate and direct patients to the most appropriate source of help. Action requests for repeat prescriptions and ensure they are processed as per our protocol within 48 hours. Opening mail and ensuring that it is directed to the correct recipient as soon as possible. Setting out letters, new prescriptions and repeat prescriptions for checking by the doctor before collection by the patient or sending to the pharmacy. Filing and extracting patients records and any documents relating to these be it from paper or electronic records. Entering patient information accurately and in a timely manner onto the patient record or clinical system. Dealing with the incoming post and other forms of communication, scanning and distributing it to the appropriate members of the practice team. Receiving and passing on messages in an accurate and timely manner to clinical and managerial staff. Pass on all requests for home visits to the appropriate clinician, ensuring careful recording of all relevant details. Explain the registration process and formal requirements to new patients and those seeking temporary cover and ensure procedures are followed. Registration and documentation of new patients to the practice, including reorganisation of patient notes when they are received. Updating patient details as requested in an accurate and timely manner. Keeping the consulting rooms and the reception areas adequately supplied with stationery and necessary equipment. Tidying the reception areas at the end of a session, ensuring that any urgent or outstanding messages and tasks are passed over to incoming colleagues for completion. Opening and closing surgery premises, checking heating and ventilation in waiting areas and switching on/off computers in reception and consulting areas. Responsibility for checking and securing the premises, setting the security alarm. Flexible to cover when needed for holidays, sickness and other absences. Willingness to adopt and contribute to new processes. Confidentiality: In the course of seeking treatment, patients entrust us with, or allow us to gather, sensitive information in relation to their health and other matters. They do so in confidence and have the right to expect that staff will respect their privacy and act appropriately. In the performance of the duties outlined in this job description, the post-holder may have access to confidential information relating to patients and their carers, practice staff and other healthcare workers. They may also have access to information relating to the practice as a business organisation. All such information from any source is to be regarded as strictly confidential. Information relating to patients, carers, colleagues, other healthcare workers or the business of the practice may only be divulged to authorised persons in accordance with the practice policies and procedures relating to confidentiality and the protection of personal and sensitive data. Health & safety: The post-holder will assist in promoting and maintaining their own and others health, safety and security as defined in the practice Health & Safety policy, the practice Health & Safety manual, and the practice Infection control policy and published procedures. This will include: Using personal security systems within the workplace according to practice guidelines. Identifying the risks involved in work activities and undertaking such activities in a way that manages those risks. Making effective use of training to update knowledge and skills. Using appropriate infection control procedures, maintaining work areas in a tidy and safe way and free from hazards. Actively reporting health and safety hazards and infection hazards immediately when recognised. Keeping own work areas and general/patient areas clean and tidy, assisting in the maintenance of general standards of cleanliness consistent with the scope of the job holder's role. Undertaking periodic infection control training. Reporting potential risks identified. Demonstrate due regard for safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children. Equality and diversity: The post-holder will support the equality, diversity and rights of patients, carers and colleagues, to include: Acting in a way that recognises the importance of people's rights, interpreting them in a way that is consistent with practice procedures and policies and current legislation. Respecting the privacy, dignity, needs and beliefs of patients, carers and colleagues. Behaving in a manner that is welcoming to and of the individual is non-judgmental and respects their circumstances, feelings, priorities and rights. Personal/Professional development: The post-holder will participate in any training programme implemented by the practice as part of this employment, such training to include: Participation in an annual individual performance review, including taking responsibility for maintaining a record of own personal and/or professional development. Taking responsibility for own development, learning and performance and demonstrating skills and activities to others who are undertaking similar work. Quality: The post-holder will strive to maintain quality within the practice, and will: Alert other team members to issues of quality and risk. Assess own performance and take accountability for own actions, either directly or under supervision. Contribute to the effectiveness of the team by reflecting on own and team activities and making suggestions on ways to improve and enhance the teams performance. Work effectively with individuals in other agencies to meet patient needs. Effectively manage own time, workload and resources. Communication: The post-holder should recognise the importance of effective communication within the team and will strive to: Communicate effectively with other team members. Communicate effectively with patients and carers. Recognise people's needs for alternative methods of communication and respond accordingly. Contribution to the implementation of services: The post-holder will: Apply practice policies, standards and guidance. Discuss with other members of the team how the policies, standards and guidelines will affect own work. Participate in audit where appropriate.

title: GP Receptionist
description: Elm Lane & Chapeltown Surgery has an exciting opportunity for a GP Receptionist (25hrs per week) to join our small friendly GP Practice. Were excited to offer the successful candidate the opportunity to join our friendly team. The role of the GP Receptionist can, at times, be very demanding so we are looking for someone who is confident, has excellent communication skills, is highly organised and good at multi-tasking. Working hours will be between the times of 8.00am - 6:30pm Monday to Friday. A normal working week would consist of working two full days (8:00am-6:30pm) and one morning (8:00am-1:30pm).During times of leave, you will be required to work up to 40 hours per week which will include three full days and two mornings (minimum of 10 weeks per year). INTERVIEWS WILL TAKE PLACE WEDNESDAY, 4 NOVEMBER 2026 PM ONLY The successful candidate will: Open and close surgery premises, including checking and securing the premises at the end of each day. Receive and direct the patients on arrival. Process requests for repeat prescriptions, ready for checking by a Doctor. Pass on all requests for home visits to the GP, ensuring careful recording of all relevant details. Deal with all general enquiries, explain surgery procedures, make new and follow-up appointments over the telephone or with direct patient contact. Receive and pass on messages for clinical and managerial staff. Ensure all urgent or outstanding messages are completed at the end of your working day. Deal with all internal and external mail and scanning onto the clinical system, where required. File, record requests for medical records and photocopy medical records. Register new patients to the practice and book new patient checks, which will also include temporary residents. Liaise with other outside agencies by telephone or email. Adopt and contribute to new processes. Undertake any other additional duties as requested by the Partners or the practice manager. Job responsibilities The successful candidate will have and be able to demonstrate: Excellent customer service skills. Previous NHS GP Practice experience is desirable but not essential; We are looking for the right person to join our dedicated team Friendly and approachable manner; Experience of working in a team; Good telephone manner; Professionalism; A can do attitude; Adept in using own initiative when working alone; Experience of working in a busy environment; The ability to multitask and prioritise effectively whilst staying calm under pressure; Has a good understanding of confidentiality; Flexibility in working pattern and duties; Ability to cope with and manage change; Computer literate. SystmOne and Accurx familiarity is desirable but training will be provided.
